key_reasoning_failure_patterns.description: Catastrophic FALSE_POSITIVE class collapse: Model labeled every CrowdStrike UltraViewer_Service.exe alert, MEGAsync.exe alert, and all 10 Prisma SASE alerts as FALSE_POSITIVE at 85% confidence despite explicit prompt warning not to treat filenames/CDN IPs as benign.

Instruction-induced missing-field hallucination: Triggered by Approved Policy criteria citing process.command_line checks, model claimed process.command_line is missing and abstained even though process.command_line ('"C:\Program Files (x86)\UltraViewer\UltraViewer_Service.exe"') was explicitly supplied.

Inability to abstain on insufficient Prisma SASE logs + network topology confusion: Model never emitted REQUIRES_ATTENTION on Prisma SASE (9 FP, 1 TP), mislabeled public AWS/CloudFront IPs (3.109.76.166, 13.35.36.32) as internal, mislabeled RFC1918 IP 172.25.14.67 as non-internal, and invented absent process telemetry.
Path/signature fabrication: Called Program Files (x86) a 'writable temporary path' (132439932) and asserted digital signature absence despite zero signature fields in CrowdStrike telemetry.
